description: This file defines the ReviewProvider class, which manages a list of Review objects, allowing addition and fetch of reviews, and notifies listeners of updates.

classes.name: ReviewProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier class managing user reviews, allowing addition and fetching of reviews with listener notifications.

methods.name: addReview
methods.description: Adds a Review object to the internal list and notifies listeners.

methods.name: fetchReviews
methods.description: Placeholder for API call to fetch reviews for a specific restaurant, currently only notifies listeners.
